instruction: A candid full shot of an indoor dance studio with a wooden floor. On the left, the man in the striped polo (R2) stands with his back to the camera, wearing olive pants and dark glasses. He is holding the woman in the red dress (R1), who stands on the right facing left. She wears a red latin dance dress and dark sunglasses, with her hair in a ponytail. They are in a close dance embrace, with his right hand on her back and her left hand on his shoulder. In the background, a bystander in dark clothing is partially visible near some chairs. Warm indoor lighting illuminates the scene, casting soft shadows on the floor.
